summary: Join Commutatus, a team of ambitious entrepreneurs, startups, and corporations in various industries to conceptualise, design, and build digital products. We are looking for a talented individual to assist in feature ideation, planning, estimation, software development, and continuous improvement.
responsibilities: Research and feasibility checks: Assist in feature ideation by providing input based on research or your experience. You’ll frequently advise the team on the feasibility of ideas and offer alternate routes to meet the objective of the feature.
Planning and estimation: You will assist the squad in planning and estimating features to ensure they are delivered on time and function as expected.

Software development: Develop front-end solutions for new features, improvements, or bug fixes planned for the platforms we manage. We build plugins/templates for features that are common across platforms.
required_skills: Resourceful - research and learn on the go
nice_to_have_skills: Built scalable digital platforms before that have been deployed to production environments
Strong understanding of state management systems such as Redux or Apollo
Experience working with JavaScript frameworks such as Angular, NextJS (React), or NuxtJS (VueJS)
Sound understanding of deploying apps to staging or production via automated tools such as GitHub Actions or Travis
benefits: Performance and compensation reviews are yearly, once you complete a year at Commutatus.
The freedom to learn and grow in the company.
A supportive team who’ll help you when you are stuck!
A learning path, feedback, and resources to take you to the next step in your technical career!
Generous health insurance and unlimited sick leave.
